instruction: How many activities are done in my bucket list as per my SimpleNote note?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the model only contains lookups. Passwords are revealed, the agent logs into SimpleNote, searches notes with query 'bucket list' to discover the note id, shows the note to read its content and count the activities marked done, then completes the task with that count as the answer. Static init facts (password-for, note-matches-query, done-count-of) only associate entities; the actual values are obtained at runtime from the API responses listed in bindings. supervisor-complete-task takes the answer count as its API parameter plus the note as an extra record parameter so its precondition can require the count to have been found; it is forced to be last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action.
